title: Chest drain insertion
summary: Open (blunt dissection) insertion of a chest drain for a traumatic pneumothorax.

anchors.name: safe_triangle
anchors.label: right safe triangle, 5th intercostal space mid-axillary line

steps.title: Introduce yourself and check identity
steps.prompt: Hello… are you the doctor doing my operation?

choices.text: Hello, I'm one of the surgical team. Can you tell me your full name and date of birth?
Yes. Let's get started straight away.
choices.feedback: Introduce yourself and confirm identity first.

steps.hint: Name, role, then two identifiers from the patient, checked against the wristband.

steps.title: Where?
steps.prompt: Where do you insert the drain?

choices.text: The safe triangle: 5th intercostal space, between latissimus dorsi and pectoralis major

choices.feedback: Risk of liver and spleen injury.

steps.title: Pick up the skin preparation
steps.hint: Alcoholic chlorhexidine, applied from the incision site outwards.

steps.title: Prepare the skin over the safe triangle
steps.hint: Centre outwards, wider than the incision; let it dry fully before drapes and diathermy (it is flammable).

steps.title: Draw up local anaesthetic
steps.hint: 1 % lidocaine; check the maximum safe dose for the patient's weight first.

steps.title: Infiltrate the safe triangle down to the pleura
steps.hint: Aspirate before injecting; wait for the anaesthetic to work.

steps.title: Incise over the upper border of the rib
steps.hint: The neurovascular bundle runs under each rib.

steps.title: Blunt dissection with curved forceps
steps.hint: Spread, don't stab; then a finger sweep.

steps.title: Open the pleura with the forceps
Insert the drain
steps.hint: No trocar: guide the tube with forceps.

steps.title: Connect the underwater seal
steps.hint: Check the water level swings with breathing.

steps.title: Secure the drain and get a chest X-ray
steps.hint: Suture, dressing; X-ray to check the position.
